pos.personaBrief: Cardoso says Sundowns usually control South African matches with 70% possession or more, and FIFA TSG calls 'shoeshine and piano' a possession-based philosophy (68% v Fluminense, 54% at Esperance). He also warns the team must be ready not to dominate the ball against stronger sides.

pro.personaBrief: FIFA TSG describes a goalkeeper-led low build-up with six players involved and Williams making 46 defensive-third passes, built on precise one-touch combinations. Cardoso's pragmatism ('sometimes strategic') leaves room for a direct ball when it is clearly on.

est.personaBrief: The structure is rehearsed: 4-2-3-1 becoming a 3-5-2-style shape with Mokoena dropping into a back three and full-backs high and wide (Mozzart, FIFA). Inside it, Zwane and Ribeiro combine between the lines and Ribeiro cuts in, while Rayners is asked to pin the centre-backs.

lar.personaBrief: The full-backs supply the width ('very high up the pitch', Mudau 'virtually a winger'; Booth on the even spread between them). The creative players, Zwane and Ribeiro, play as dual No.10s or move inside, so the attacking focus is central.

blo.personaBrief: The evidence is thin (tier C): a 4-1-4-1 with lateral pressure v Fluminense, a line pushed up after set pieces, and Sundowns 'pressed for long spells' when trailing at Siwelele. A dominant possession side in the PSL reads as one that wins the ball back high, but against stronger opponents it accepts suffering.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal marking at set pieces v Fluminense (Mozzart), and the shape-based 4-1-4-1 that funnels play to the flanks, point to a zonal defending model with no man-marking of individual stars.

pla.personaBrief: Cardoso: 'You can't play the same way in Rades as you do at Loftus' and 'football taught me otherwise'. He changed things at half-time (Raja rebalance, Lunga and Sales at Rades, a triple change at Siwelele), and he took over Sundowns' existing 'shoeshine and piano' tradition rather than imposing his own model from scratch.

res.personaBrief: Cardoso calls himself a once 'too romantic' coach who now accepts being 'strategic'. Away results in Africa came from 'tactical discipline and an appetite to suffer' (Business Report), which points to a result-first approach with some leftover attachment to style.

sis.personaBrief: The play rests on rehearsed collective mechanisms (rotations in the low build-up, defined roles for the holders, a pinning striker; FIFA TSG), with gifted players working inside the system rather than as free agents.

jog.personaBrief: The squad is described as 'some of the best technically gifted players in the country': a passing goalkeeper, Mokoena as a holder who drops to receive, and Zwane and Ribeiro between the lines (FIFA, Business Report). Technique clearly comes before physicality.

bas.personaBrief: No verified evidence; this comes from general knowledge. Sundowns 2025 was a big-budget champion squad built on established internationals and signings (Ribeiro, Allende, Rayners, Sales), and a youth policy was not central to its title and CAF ambitions.

lid.personaBrief: No verified evidence; this comes from general knowledge. Cardoso comes across as a calm, cerebral coach who protects his group publicly while keeping firm control of the rules and the line-up, which mixes authority with care for the group.
